## 1. Seniority of Re-employed Ex-T.B., Ex-Pleurisy and Ex-Leprosy Patients  
- 1.1. Counting Previous Service.Ex-T.B., ex-Pleurisy, and ex-Leprosy patients declared non-infective and medically fit for Government service, when re-employed in the same posts from which they were discharged, should have their actual previous service counted for seniority. Seniority in other posts will be fixed in consultation with the Department of Personnel and Training.
